how_value_is_shown: Spoken and subtitled: a children's book personalised by the baby's face; shown with the baby's face on covers and pages next to a baby on the mat.
demonstration: Baby touches the covers; a hand turns a page of the open book
proof: A baby's face on the illustrated covers and pages (children's images in animation style); no direct photo-versus-illustration comparison.
emotion: Calm, gentle, tender; the wartime context is stated (shelter, uncertainty)
personal_story: Caption: since the war began she keeps looking for small things that are good for the heart and found this; the ordering was easy and pleasant.
selling_language: 'קוד הנחה של 10% - lotem10' (caption); 'ספר ילדים מותאם אישית לפי הפנים של הבייבי' (caption); 'חוויית ההזמנה מהאתר הייתה כל כך קלה ונעימה' (caption)
captions_on_screen: Burned-in subtitles of the voiceover, white sans-serif with shadow at lower middle; 'MeBook' shown in bold; a final text 'פרטים למטה' with a pointing-down emoji.
editing_rhythm: About 6 shots in 17 s, average about 2.8 s; clean cuts, no obvious speed changes.
ending_and_cta: Last 3 s: baby from behind facing the open book; text 'פרטים למטה' with a pointing-down emoji; caption gives a 10% discount code lotem10 and the brand tag.
price_or_code: caption: 'קוד הנחה של 10% - lotem10'; no price shown
convincing: Interpretation: a short, quiet clip with a real baby next to the book and the face-based personalisation visible on the cover; the opening question speaks to parents' stress.
weak_or_overproduced: Interpretation: the clip is very short; the likeness claim relies on the cover, and the baby's real face is seen only in profile or from behind, so the personalisation is not proved by comparison; the code is only in the caption.
lumebook_lesson: Interpretation: a direct question hook, a real baby next to the open book, and one burned-in subtitle line per sentence are easy to copy. The wartime framing is time-sensitive and should be judged carefully. For LumeBook the clear gap is a photo beside the illustrated page to prove likeness.
solo_without_child: partly: book-only shots and subtitles can be filmed alone, but the baby's reaction is the emotional core
not_verified: Whether the baby's real face resembles the cover face was not established (the real face is only partly visible in the frames). The baby is probably 6 to 9 months old (estimate). Music not determined. 'MeBook' is a direct competitor per project notes.
